final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: This reuses the approved answer word for word (control CC6.2, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16). Section 4.3 of the Access Control Policy also gives the 24-hour limit. I didn't check this live because none of the available checks covers removing leavers' access.

policy:488b979e-a475-411c-8713-b42a7f10d: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:13c1aa65-ed35-408d-9df6-d7d9a8ed7: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
policy:9be3d2dd-a63a-4d9b-9b7d-291495dd0: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
answer:b2450366-987c-43b6-b2c8-08ab667f1: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:569cb671-6743-4da0-8932-662316778: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
